Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300, depending on qualification. Online applications started on 29 Octo

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: ONGC reserves the right to extend the application deadline if sufficient applications or suitable candidates are not available. Candidates should follow official announcements for any subsequent changes.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: ONGC has advertised 3,047 apprenticeship positions across its operational locations. The notification provides separate sector-wise, work-centre-wise and trade-wise seat tables. The notification refers to 24 work centres, while its vacancy table separately names OVL Delhi and several other operating locations. The centre names and seat figures above reproduce the published entries. Applicants should select only the work centre and trade options available on the relevant official application portal. content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must not have completed three years after passing their qualifying examination as on 29 November 2026 . Applicants whose marksheets do not mention the result declaration date must produce a certificate confirming the result publication date from the relevant institution during document verification. Candidates who have previously undergone apprenticeship training are not eligible. Candidates currently pursuing apprenticeship training are not eligible. For Technician Apprentices, candidates with one year or more of training or work experience after acquiring the prescribed qualification are not eligible. All applicants must satisfy the relevant NAPS or NATS scheme conditions.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited has released for apprenticeship engagement under the Apprentices Act, 1961. The official 20-page notification provides the work-centre-wise and trade-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, age relaxation, stipend, selection process, application instructions and district eligibility conditions in Annexure I. Official Notification PDF: Download ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The prescribed age limit is 18 to 24 years as on 29 November 2026 . Age relaxation is subject to eligibility and applicable Government reservation guidelines.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300 , depending on the qualification and apprenticeship category. The stipend is payable during the 12-month apprenticeship engagement. ONGC will not provide additional TA/DA, boarding, lodging or transportation financial assistance during training.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: Important: ONGC states that it has no obligation to provide regular employment during or after the apprenticeship. Candidates will be relieved from their respective training locations after successful completion of the programme.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates should complete the application through the respective Government NAPS or NATS portal and follow only the instructions provided through the official recruitment channels.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on merit in the prescribed qualifying examination , followed by document verification and completion of the applicable apprenticeship engagement formalities. Application Scrutiny: ONGC will consolidate and verify applications submitted through NAPS and NATS. Provisional Merit List: Merit will be determined using marks obtained in the prescribed qualifying examination for the relevant trade and work centre. Shortlisting: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted according to available seats and merit. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original qualification, age, category and other required certificates. Final Selection: ONGC will prepare the final merit list after verifying eligibility and applying the reservation rules. Engagement Formalities: Selected candidates must complete the applicable NAPS/NATS apprenticeship registration and contract requirements. In case two candidates obtain the same marks in the qualifying examination, the older candidate will receive preference , according to the notified selection criteria. The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination for apprentice selection. The announced selection method uses qualifying examination marks, eligibility scrutiny and document verification.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must apply through the relevant apprenticeship portal based on the NAPS or NATS scheme shown against the selected trade in the ONGC notification. NAPS Apply Online: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme Portal NATS Apply Online: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme Portal ONGC Apprenticeship Website: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment Portal Last Date: 20 November 2026. Applicants must use the scheme applicable to their selected trade or discipline. Merely registering on NAPS or NATS without completing the relevant ONGC opportunity application does not establish a successfully submitted application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Applications through hard copy, post, hand delivery or other offline methods will not be accepted. Candidates should follow the one-trade and one-work-centre application instructions stated in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates must produce the required original documents and self-attested photocopies at the notified verification venue. Matriculation certificate or other accepted date-of-birth proof. 10th, 12th, ITI, Diploma or Degree certificate, as applicable. Qualifying examination marksheets. Result declaration certificate, where the passing date is not shown in the marksheet. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS category certificate, if applicable. PwBD certificate, where applicable. Valid identity proof. NAPS or NATS registration and submitted application details. Proof supporting the notified work-centre district eligibility, as required. Other documents requested by ONGC during verification. Providing incorrect information, concealing material facts or failing to produce the required original certificates can result in cancellation of candidature or termination of apprenticeship engagement.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Result 2026
content_sections.text: ONGC has scheduled the Apprentice Selection Result for 15 December 2026 . The final merit list or selection list will be published on the official ONGC apprenticeship website and/or communicated through the registered email address. Result Website: ONGC Apprentice Selection Updates Candidates should regularly check their registered email and the official portal for selection, document verification and joining instructions. The notification does not specify a separate individual result communication method for every applicant.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ONGC has advertised 3,047 Apprentice positions across its work centres under Advertisement No. ONGC/APPR/1/2026. The PDF contains a discrepancy between its printed grand total and sector subtotals.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online applications is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by trade and include 10th, 12th, relevant ITI, three-year Engineering Diploma, B.Com, BBA, B.Sc., B.E./B.Tech. and other specified graduate qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 24 years as on 29 November 2026, with applicable relaxation for SC, ST, OBC-NCL and PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for ONGC Apprentices in 2026?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend ranges from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300, depending on whether the candidate is a 10th/12th Pass, ITI, Diploma or Graduate Apprentice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on qualifying examination marks, followed by document verification and final merit preparation. No separate written examination is specified.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from any state apply for every ONGC work centre?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must satisfy the applicable domicile or qualifying-institution district requirements listed in Annexure I of the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is NAPS or NATS registration required?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must apply through NAPS or NATS according to the scheme assigned to their selected trade or discipline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of ONGC Apprentice training?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training duration is 12 months for all notified trades.

faq.question: Q10. Does ONGC provide a permanent job after apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. ONGC states that completion of apprenticeship does not create an entitlement to regular employment.
